In this section, we show how to use multicalibration with respect to the Hadamard groups to control the bias term. The key observation is that Parseval’s identity (Proposition 2 ) lets us relate the average squared bias coefficient across Hadamard directions to the total bias energy. Since multicalibration controls the error in each Hadamard direction, on average the bias contribution must be small.
